evidence: The frozen workbook's quality row 7 says real build work is required and a stub or trivial tweak cannot earn reward; the frozen quality-checks.md check 7 asks whether a static page, single CRUD screen or mock could satisfy the smallest submission. The public brief asks for an editor that formats, changes and runs authored JavaScript/HTML and keeps revisions across competing tabs (task/instruction.md:1-5). Public notes require a custom document text model with caret, selection and undo (environment/instructions/ui.md:3-15), isolated execution and ordered console plus last-good recovery (environment/instructions/behaviour.md:3-5), and durable shared save/history with stale-revision refusal (environment/instructions/behaviour.md:9-11; integration.md:7). The smallest compliant submission therefore requires an interactive editor, actual code execution, and server-backed revision state. A plausible static shell or canned demo cannot satisfy the Render all-pass gate: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires a browser-entered program using judge-chosen integers, then two real button clicks with increasing preview and console totals. A browser-local CRUD mock also fails the Constraints all-pass gate: tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 rejects a ready-made/document textarea surface and :32 requires a unique Save plus exact server readback in a separate clean browser context and after reload. tests/scoring.toml:1-11 assigns zero gate mass and a functional floor, and tests/tools/score.py applies the gates and floor before reward. A conforming canvas/SVG/DOM editor using a small keyboard input remains permitted by ui.md:3 and the gate at constraints/judge.toml:23; implementation style alone should not fail it. A conforming server-rendered Save using POST followed by a redirect and fresh GET could be falsely failed if constraints/judge.toml:32 is read to require the write response body itself to contain all three fields; the public integration.md:5 permits chosen routes, and the fresh readback is the actual persistence evidence. That is an adjacent gate-fairness concern for reconciliation, separate from this row's build-depth question. Source review therefore supports this row. The manifest input hash was checked, and the frozen workbook/render/constraints hashes match its entries. No raw-evidence-index.json or actual weak-app/full-judge run exists in this run, so empirical rejection of a crafted mock and actual reward behavior remain unmeasured; risk stays true and no score is claimed.
